messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to chat with me today about the enhancements to the university student portal. To start off, could you share what the main goals are for these new features like the personalised timetable management, grade notifications, and module feedback?

Hey! Thanks for having me. So, I guess my main goals would be to make the timetable a lot easier to read and use. It’s kind of a mess right now, and I think if we could colour-code stuff or hide the classes that get cancelled, it would help a ton. 

Also, I really want to know when grades come out without having to constantly check. It would be great if I could get a notification or something when a new grade is posted. 

And for feedback, I think it would be nice to have a way to share my thoughts on modules after the semester ends. It feels like there’s no way to do that right now, and I’d like to be able to let them know what’s working or not.

Thanks for sharing those goals! They sound really helpful. So, just to clarify, for the personalised timetable management, you mentioned wanting to make it easier to read and use with features like colour-coding and the ability to hide cancelled classes. Is that right?

Yeah, exactly! It would just make it so much clearer if I could see my classes in different colours or just get rid of the ones that aren't happening. I think that would really help me stay organised and not feel so overwhelmed by the whole timetable.

Got it! So, colour-coding the classes and hiding cancelled ones would help you stay organised and less overwhelmed. Moving on to the grade notifications, could you tell me how you envision receiving those notifications? Would you prefer them via email, in-app notifications, or maybe something else?

I think getting a notification in the app would be the best. It’s just easier to see it right there when I’m using the portal. But if I could also get an email, that would be cool too, just in case I miss it in the app. I just don’t want to have to keep checking all the time!

That makes sense! So, you’d like to have notifications for grades in the app, with an option for email notifications as a backup. That would definitely help you avoid constantly checking. Now, about the module feedback system, could you give me an example of what kind of feedback you’d want to share after a semester?

Hmm, well, I think I'd want to talk about how the module was taught, like if the content was clear or if the resources were helpful. It would be good to mention things I liked or didn’t like about how the classes went. Just stuff that could help improve the module for future students. I feel like I have opinions on this, but I just don’t know how to put it all down in a structured way!

Thanks for that example! So, you’d like to provide feedback on the teaching quality, clarity of content, and the helpfulness of resources, and you want a way to do this in a structured manner. That sounds really useful for improving future modules. 

Lastly, are there any limitations or restrictions we should be aware of when implementing these features in the portal?

Um, I haven't really thought about any limitations. I just know it would be great if these features didn’t mess with how the portal works now. I’d just want everything to be easy to access without having to create new accounts or anything like that. But yeah, I’m not really sure about any specific restrictions.

Got it! So, you want to ensure that these new features don’t disrupt the current portal functionality and that everything remains easy to access without needing new accounts. 

To summarise your requirements: 

1. Personalised timetable management with colour-coding and the ability to hide cancelled classes.
2. Grade notifications through in-app alerts and optional email notifications.
3. A structured module feedback system to share thoughts on teaching quality and resources.
4. The new features should not disrupt the existing portal functionality.
5. No need for students to create new accounts to access these features.

Thank you for sharing all this information! 

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
